schemaNote: GPIR content-factory contract. This file defines shared vocabulary and metadata requirements for future records; it does not publish content or replace the existing country, announcement, source or registry datasets.

editionLifecycleFields.schemaNote: Defines the GPIR CURRENT/DEVELOPING/HISTORICAL lifecycle contract for versioned content. Lifecycle, publication, validation and source-trust states remain separate so unreviewed material cannot be represented as validated current intelligence.
editionLifecycleFields.rule: CURRENT is the primary public state only after GPIR classification and content validation. DEVELOPING is reviewable but not public validated intelligence. A record only moves to HISTORICAL when an explicit newer validated edition is recorded; preserve the prior record, its original source URL and reciprocal supersedes/supersededBy lineage. No record is classified as HISTORICAL by age or inference alone.

recordRules.sourceUrl: Required when source is supplied; use HTTPS and preserve the original publisher URL.
recordRules.publicationDate: Required when the cited source has a publication date; use YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
recordRules.retrievalDate: Required when a source is reviewed; use YYYY-MM-DD.
recordRules.evidenceClassification: Required for published research claims; distinguish FACT, DATA, ANALYSIS, ESTIMATE and FORECAST.
recordRules.unsupportedFreshness: Do not use live, real-time, hourly or continuously updated as a content-freshness claim without verified ingestion evidence.
recordRules.lifecycle: Only an explicit newer validated edition may supersede a record; preserve superseded records and original source URLs.
recordRules.refreshCycle: Use MANUAL until a verified scheduled ingestion mechanism exists.
